compute_msa_features: compute MSA features from token layouts with paired and unpaired sequence alignments for each chain
compute_template_features: compute template features from PDB structures including atom positions and masks for protein chains
compute_token_features: compute per-token features including residue index, aatype, chain symmetry IDs, and token type boolean masks
tokenize_atom_layout: map a flat atom layout to evoformer tokens with one representative atom per polymer residue or ligand atom
compute_reference_structure: compute reference structure features from CCD entries or SMILES strings using RDKit conformer generation
